list.title: Chat rooms
list.description: Chat with other trainers on PokéIQ: the Main Lobby, Pokédle, Connections, Pikadoku, PokéGuessr, Battle and Quizzes rooms.
list.label: Community
list.heading: Chat <hl>rooms</hl>
list.intro: Talk Pokémon with other trainers. Anyone can read; sign in to chat. Moderators keep every room friendly.

siteRules.0: Be kind. No bullying, swearing or hate.
siteRules.1: Never share personal details: your real name, age, school, address, phone or socials.
siteRules.2: Links can't be posted. Talk about the game!
siteRules.3: Spot something wrong? Use the flag to report a message. Moderators read every report.

lobby.0: Keep it friendly and on topic: Pokémon and PokéIQ.
lobby.1: Beginners welcome: answer questions patiently, never make fun of one.

pokedle.0: No spoilers: never post today's answer or big hints.

connections.0: No spoilers: never post today's groups.

pikadoku.0: No spoilers: never post today's answers.

battle.0: No asking for or arranging wins: play every battle for real.
battle.1: Rate teams kindly: say what works, then what you'd change.

quizzes.0: No posting answers to a quiz someone is playing.
